errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is referenced in a reservation but no customer with the given customer_id exists.

errors.name: RoomNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a room is referenced in a reservation but no room with the given room_id exists.

errors.name: ReservationOverlapError
errors.description: Raised when a new reservation overlaps with an existing reservation in the same room.
